info.name: Ashqe App — Complete API Collection v3
info.description:
Full mobile-app API collection for Ashqe (Flutter / React Native).

**Base URL:** `https://ashqe.app`  (or `http://localhost:3000` for local dev)
**Auth:** After OTP/login, the test script auto-saves `accessToken` and `userId` to collection variables.

All protected routes require:
  `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`

Optional per-profile header:
  `x-profile-id: <profileId>`

Folders:
 01 — Auth
 02 — Home & Discovery
 03 — Movie Detail
 04 — Series (Web Series) Detail
 05 — Watch / Video Player
 06 — Watch Progress & History
 07 — Like / Unlike
 08 — Wishlist (Watchlist)
 09 — Reviews
 10 — Downloads
 11 — Share
 12 — Views (Track View Count)
 13 — Subscription & Plans
 14 — User Profile
 15 — Notifications
 16 — App Settings & Config

item.name: 01 — Auth
item.description: OTP, email/password, Google, Apple login — no auth required

request.description:
Send 4-digit OTP to mobile number.
Returns `verificationId` — pass it to Verify OTP.

**Body:**
- `mobileNumber` — 10-digit Indian mobile number (leading country code stripped automatically)

Verify OTP and receive JWT.

**Test script auto-saves** `accessToken` and `userId` to collection variables.

**Body fields:**
- `mobileNumber` — 10-digit number
- `verificationId` — from Send OTP response
- `otp` — 4–8 digit code
- `name` — display name (used only on first registration)
- `deviceId` — unique device identifier for device-limit tracking
- `deviceName` — human-readable device name

**Response includes:**
- `accessToken`, `userId`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `avatar`
- `subscriptionPlan`, `subscriptionStatus`, `subscriptionExpiry`
- `isNewUser` — true if this was first registration
- `expiresIn` — 604800 (7 days)

response.name: 200 — OTP Verified
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "userId": "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1",
  "name": "Test User",
  "email": null,
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "avatar": null,
  "subscriptionPlan": "free",
  "subscriptionPlanName": null,
  "subscriptionStatus": "inactive",
  "subscriptionExpiry": null,
  "subscription": false,
  "walletBalance": 0,
  "profileLimitCount": 1,
  "isNewUser": false,
  "expiresIn": 604800
}

request.description:
Register a new user with email + password.

If `phone` is provided and an existing OTP-only account is found for that phone, the accounts are linked automatically.

**Body:**
- `name` (required)
- `email` (required — must be unique)
- `password` (required — min 6 chars)
- `phone` (optional — 10-digit)

Login with email or phone number + password.

The `email` field accepts either an email address OR a phone number (no `@` → treated as phone).

**Returns:** accessToken, userId, name, email, phone, avatar, subscriptionPlan, subscriptionStatus, walletBalance

Google OAuth Sign-In.
Pass the Google ID token from `google_sign_in` Flutter package.
Requires Google Sign-In to be enabled in admin settings.

Apple Sign-In.
Pass Apple `identityToken`. The `user` object (name + email) is only sent by Apple on the FIRST sign-in — cache it in the app.
Requires Apple Sign-In to be enabled in admin settings.

Logout. Clears the device list for the user.
Always returns 200 — even if token is expired.
Invalidate the token on the client side after calling this.

Set preferred content language after OTP verification (post-onboarding language picker screen).
Also accepts `languageId` (ObjectId) or language `code`.
Skip language selection step. Sets preferredLanguage = Hindi and languageSelectionSkipped = true.
Debug endpoint — check if Message Central OTP gateway is configured on the server.

item.name: 03 — Movie Detail
item.description: GET full movie detail page data — auth optional

request.description:
Returns full movie detail for the movie detail screen:

**Media:**
- `thumbnail`, `bannerImage`, `posterImage`, `trailerUrl`
- `hlsUrl` — only returned when user can access the content
- `videoSettings[]` — quality list: { key, label, description, url, requiresPlan, isLocked }
  - auto=free, 720p=basic, 1080p=standard, 4K=premium
- `playbackSpeeds[]` — [0.75x, Normal, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, 2.0x]

**Meta:**
- `title`, `originalTitle`, `description`, `shortDescription`
- `genres[]`, `genresText`, `languages[]`
- `year`, `rating`, `ageRating`, `imdbRating`
- `duration`, `durationFormatted`
- `planRequired`, `isLocked`, `requiresSubscription`
- `isExclusive`, `featured`, `trending`, `releaseDate`, `country`, `studio`

**Stats:** `views`, `likeCount`, `shares`

**User flags (auth required):**
- `isLikedByUser`, `isWishlisted`, `watchProgress`, `isDownloaded`

**People:** `cast[]`, `crew[]`
**Related:** `related[]`
**Share:** `shareUrl`

item.name: 05 — 🎬 Web Series & TV Shows — Complete API
item.description:
ALL APIs for Web Series / TV Shows in 5 sub-folders.

1. App — Series Discovery & Detail  (public / optional auth)
2. App — Watch / Video Player       (public / optional auth)
3. App — User Interactions          (auth required)
4. Admin — TV Shows CRUD            (admin JWT + RBAC)
5. Admin — Episodes CRUD            (admin JWT + RBAC)

item.name: 1. App — Series Discovery & Detail
item.description: Public / optional-auth endpoints for the app user.

header.description: Optional — unlocks isLikedByUser, isWishlisted, premium episode HLS URLs

request.description:
Full series detail for the detail screen.

Response fields:
- id, title, originalTitle, description, shortDescription
- thumbnail, bannerImage, posterImage, trailerUrl
- contentType (tvshow|drama), isLocked, requiresSubscription
- genres[], genresText, languages[]
- year, rating, ageRating, imdbRating
- planRequired (free|basic|standard|premium)
- episodeCount, isExclusive, featured, trending

- shareUrl

Paginated infinite-scroll list of web series with optional filters for genre, language, sort order, and year.
Returns trending keywords + paginated series matching the search query.
Returns all home sections — trending, new releases, exclusive, etc. Includes both movies and series cards.

item.name: 2. App — Watch / Video Player
item.description: Video player page data for episodes — auth optional (pass token to unlock paid content).

item.name: Watch Episode — by Season & Episode Number

request.description:
Pass the TVShow _id as contentId. Returns full player data for a specific season+episode.

Response: content (meta+cast+episodes), currentEpisode (hlsUrl, videoSettings[], watchProgress, isLocked), playbackSpeeds[], userAccess

Quality Gate:
- auto / 480p and below: free
- 720p HD: basic plan
- 1080p Full HD: standard plan
- 1440p 2K / 2160p 4K: premium plan

currentEpisode.videoSettings example:
[
  { key: "auto",  label: "Auto",          url: "https://...", requiresPlan: "free",     isLocked: false },
  { key: "480p",  label: "480p SD",       url: "https://...", requiresPlan: "free",     isLocked: false },
  { key: "720p",  label: "720p HD",       url: null,         requiresPlan: "basic",    isLocked: true  },
  { key: "1080p", label: "1080p Full HD", url: null,         requiresPlan: "standard", isLocked: true  },
  { key: "2160p", label: "4K Ultra HD",   url: null,         requiresPlan: "premium",  isLocked: true  }
]
Fetch player data for a specific episode using its direct _id. Useful when navigating from watch history, episode list, or deep link.
No season/episode params — server auto-loads Season 1, Episode 1 (or first available episode). Use this for "Play Now" button on series detail screen.

Save or upsert watch progress for an episode. Call every 10-30 seconds during playback.

request.description: Returns progressSeconds, durationSeconds, progressPercent for a specific episode.
Returns watch history sorted by most recently watched. Includes series with season, episode, progressPercent.
Remove all watch progress records for a specific episode.
Increment view count for a web series. Call once when user starts playing.

request.description: Update any field on an existing TV show via $set. Partial updates supported.
Delete a TV show AND ALL its episodes. Also removes the show from all sections it was assigned to.
Change publish status. Values: published | draft | processing | moderation | rejected
Toggle the featured flag. No body needed — automatically flips current value.
Toggle the trending flag. No body needed — automatically flips current value.
Returns TV shows in moderation status waiting for admin approval. Shows createdBy (name + email).

request.description: Update any field on an existing episode. If sourceVideoUrl changes to a new local MP4, HLS transcoding is re-queued. Auto-syncs HLS qualities after update.

item.name: 06 — Watch / Video Player
item.description: Video player page data — HLS URL, quality list, episode list, progress — auth optional

**Quality Gate:**

item.name: 07 — Watch Progress & History
item.description: Save/get watch position and history — all require 🔐 auth

request.description:
Upsert watch progress. Call every ~10–30 seconds during playback.

**Required:** `contentId`, `progressSeconds`, `durationSeconds`
**Optional:** `episodeId` (for TV episodes — pass episode `_id`, not show `_id`), `contentType`

Also increments `User.totalWatchTime` by the delta since last save.

query.description: Episode ID — overrides contentId for episodes

request.description: Returns `progressSeconds`, `durationSeconds`, `progressPercent` for one content item. Returns `data: null` if no progress saved yet.

Returns paginated watch history sorted by most recently watched.
Deduplicated by content — only most recent episode shown per show.
Remove all watch progress records for a specific content (movie ID or episode ID).

Delete a single item from watch history.
Accepts the progress document `_id` or the `contentId`. Tries `_id` first, then falls back to `contentId`.
Delete ALL watch history and progress records for the authenticated user.

item.name: 08 — Like / Unlike
item.description: Toggle like on content — requires 🔐 auth

request.description:
Toggle like on a movie or TV show.
- Not liked → likes it → `isLikedByUser: true`
- Already liked → unlikes it → `isLikedByUser: false`

**contentType values:** `movie` | `tvshow` | `drama`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Video liked successfully",
  "data": { "likeCount": 4201, "isLikedByUser": true }
}
```

item.name: 09 — Wishlist (Watchlist)
item.description: Add/remove content from watchlist and fetch the list — requires 🔐 auth

request.description:
Toggle watchlist via URL param.
- Not wishlisted → adds → `isWishlisted: true`
- Already wishlisted → removes → `isWishlisted: false`

**contentType values:** `movie` | `tvshow` | `drama`
Alternative form — pass `contentId` in the request body instead of the URL.

Returns paginated wishlist items with:
`id`, `contentId`, `title`, `poster`, `backdrop`, `type`, `year`, `duration`, `imdbRating`, `ageRating`, `description`, `language`, `genres[]`, `addedAt`

item.name: 10 — Reviews
item.description: Platform reviews (not per-content) — GET public, POST/DELETE require 🔐 auth

request.description:
Returns published platform reviews with:
- `data[]` — reviews with userId.name, userId.avatar, rating, comment
- `stats` — averageRating, totalReviews, distribution (star 1–5 counts)
- `pagination`

Submit a platform review.
Each user can only submit ONE review — returns 400 if they already have one.

**rating:** 1–5 (required)
**comment:** string (optional)
Delete your own review by its document `_id`. Returns 404 if not found or not owned by you.

item.name: 11 — Downloads
item.description: Offline download authorization — requires 🔐 auth + active paid subscription with downloadStatus=true

request.description:
Authorize a movie for offline download.

**Checks:**
1. User must have an active paid subscription
2. Plan must have `downloadStatus = true`
3. Download limit not exceeded
4. Movie must have `downloadAllowed = true`
5. Movie must have a non-HLS progressive MP4 file

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "...",
    "downloadUrl": "https://...",
    "isHls": false,
    "videoQualities": [{ "quality": "720p", "label": "720P", "sizeFormatted": "850 MB", "url": "..." }],
    "downloadLimit": 10,
    "downloadUsed": 3
  }
}
```

**Error 403:** Free plan or download limit reached
**Error 404:** No downloadable file found
Returns all authorized downloads for the user with `downloadUrl`, quality list, status, and progress.
Remove a single download record by its document `_id`.
Delete ALL download records for the authenticated user.

item.name: 12 — Share
item.description: Smart deep-link share redirect and share count tracking

request.description:
Smart deep-link redirect page. Increments share count, then:
- Android → opens app via Intent or falls back to Play Store
- iOS → opens app via custom scheme or falls back to App Store
- Desktop → redirects to web player

This is the URL you embed in `shareUrl` shared via WhatsApp/social media.

Increment share count for a content item via API (without redirect).
Call when the user taps the share button in-app.

**Returns:** `{ success: true, data: { sharesCount: 43 } }`

item.name: 13 — Views (Track View Count)
item.description: Record a content view — auth optional

request.description:
Increment view count for a content item.
Call once when the user starts playing (not repeatedly).

**contentType:** `movie` | `tvshow`

item.name: 14 — Subscription & Plans
item.description: Plans list (public) + Razorpay payment flow (requires 🔐 auth)

request.description:
Returns all active subscription plans for the paywall/subscription screen.
No auth required.

**Response per plan:**
- `id`, `name`, `duration`, `durationValue`
- `price` — original price
- `discount` — % discount
- `totalPrice` — final charge amount
- `description`, `level`

exec: if (r.isFree) console.log('✅ Free plan activated directly.');

request.description:
Create a Razorpay payment order.

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "order": { "id": "order_XXXX", "amount": 29900, "currency": "INR" },
  "keyId": "rzp_live_XXXX"
}
```

**Free plan** (totalPrice = 0): plan is activated directly without Razorpay, returns `{ isFree: true, subscriptionId: ... }`

Use `order.id` + `keyId` to open Razorpay checkout in Flutter.

Verify Razorpay HMAC signature and activate the subscription.

**On success:**
- Old active subscriptions marked inactive
- New subscription created
- `User.subscriptionPlan`, `subscriptionStatus`, `subscriptionExpiry` updated

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "subscription": true,
  "subscriptionPlan": "Premium Monthly",
  "subscriptionStatus": "active",
  "subscriptionExpiry": "2026-10-25T..."
}
```
